item.command:
"C:\\Users\\ww\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command '$currentDirectory = (Get-Location).Path
Write-Output ('"'当前目录: ' + "'$currentDirectory)
$relativePaths = @('"'.agents/skills/cineweave-director/SKILL.md', '.agents/skills/cineweave-director/references/optional/video-platform-adaptation.md', '.agents/skills/cineweave-director/references/optional/video-model-practices-2026-10.md')
foreach ("'$relativePath in $relativePaths) {
    $hashResult = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $relativePath -Algorithm SHA256 -ErrorAction Stop
    $fileText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $relativePath -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction Stop
    $replacementCount = [regex]::Matches($fileText, [string][char]0xFFFD).Count
    [pscustomobject]@{ Path = $relativePath; SHA256 = $hashResult.Hash; U_FFFD_Count = $replacementCount } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
}'
